Shareholder-ministry hub aggregating all four state banks' financial reporting; URL verification failed, re-check liveness before approving.

Association covering >95% of banking-system assets, both roster and committee outputs; URL verification failed, re-check reachability.
Fintech association hub with member list plus news feed — the payments/fintech actor layer, equal weight to banking per scope.
One-off annual fintech catalogue PDF (mirrored on a gov domain): high-value roster and market sizing, but a static artefact.

Roster of non-bank finance companies and microlenders (payments-adjacent long tail); URL failed, re-check before harvesting.
Credit-union directory — peripheral retail-finance population; verification failed and value is secondary to A1 disclosures.
